source.author: ov
source.text: Nec Caenis in ullos denupsit thalamos secretaque litora carpens aequorei vim passa dei est ita fama ferebat, utque novae Veneris Neptunus gaudia cepit, sint tua vota licet dixit secura repulsae: elige, quid voveas!
source.text_original: Nec Caenis in ullos / denupsit thalamos secretaque litora carpens / aequorei vim passa dei est (ita fama ferebat), / utque novae Veneris Neptunus gaudia cepit, / 'sint tua vota licet' dixit 'secura repulsae: / elige, quid voveas!'
source.text_english: Nor did Caenis ever remarry to any bridal chamber, and as she wandered the secluded shores she endured the violence of the sea god, so ran the tale; and when Neptune had taken the pleasures of the new Venus, he said, safe from any refusal, “Though your prayers may be granted, choose what you wish to ask for!”
